Title: A Golden Chaine: or, the Description of Theologie, containing the order of the causes of Salvation and Damnation, according to Gods word; whereunto is adjoined the order which M. Theodore Beza used in comforting afflicted consciences (with An Exposition of the Symbole or Creed, An Exposition of the Lords Prayer, A Treatise tending unto a Declaration whether a man be in the estate of damnation or grace, A Case of Conscience, A Direction for the Government of the Tongue, Two Treatises of Repentance and the Combat, and other treatises collected in the same volume)
Creator: William Perkins (1558-1602) (with a table after Theodore Beza)
Publisher: Printed by John Legat, printer to the University of Cambridge
Publication Date: 1600
Rights: Public Domain (printed 1600, pd-us-by-date)
Source: Internet Archive item goldenchaineorde00perk, file goldenchaineorde00perk_djvu.txt, fetched directly by the library/source-research thread (Era VII session), 2026-10-16; host rights statement: possible-copyright-status NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT (contributor Princeton Theological Seminary Library).
Provenance note: Header prepended; the OCR text follows unchanged apart from long-s (U+017F) to s, 0 replacements (none were present: this scan's OCR already renders the long s as f or s inconsistently, which is left as found). Rights basis restated: a 1600 Cambridge imprint is public domain in the United States by date.
Content note: SECOND WITNESS, not a clean quoting text (Mark's OCR ruling, 2026-09-25): the 1600 black-letter and roman print was OCR'd with systematic long-s misreads (faluation, Chrift, fuch) and broken words at the page edges; sampled at 10/30/50/70/90 per cent and found readable but garbled in every sample. The volume collects several Perkins works: A Golden Chaine in 58 chapters (chapter headings CHAP. n from about line 1255), An Exposition of the Creed (from about line 19809, with running heads 'of the Creede'), An Exposition of the Lords Prayer (about line 34368), A Treatise tending unto a Declaration (contents at line 503), A Case of Conscience, A Direction for the Government of the Tongue (about line 48106), Two Treatises (about line 49737), with the volume's own contents lists at lines 349-569. Use for locating passages; verify any quotation against the page images before it is relied on.
